quote: When official traffic-control devices are erected giving notice thereof, a person shall not drive a vehicle onto or from any controlled-access highway except at those entrances and exits which are indicated by such devices.

activation.condition: Official traffic-control devices erected giving notice of indicated access points for a separately established controlled-access highway.

obligation.description: A person shall not drive a vehicle onto or from the highway except at indicated entrances and exits.

timing.description: Assess official notice and exact entry or exit boundary crossing in original route frames.
